name: Autocomplete for WooCommerce Orders
author: hplugin

sections.description:
Tired of manually marking WooCommerce orders as “Completed”?

Autocomplete for WooCommerce Orders automatically completes orders after successful payment based on product type, payment method, customer role, and global rules — no coding required.

This plugin works perfectly for physical, digital, virtual, and downloadable products, helping store owners save time and automate order processing.

Why Store Owners Choose Autocomplete for WooCommerce Orders

  • Automatically complete WooCommerce orders after payment
  • Smart conditions based on payment gateway, product type, and user role
  • Improve customer experience with instant order completion
  • Compatible with PayPal, Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, and more
  • Cash on Delivery and Bank Transfer excluded by default for safety
  • Optimized for large stores processing 20,000–30,000+ orders
  • Lightweight and performance-friendly

Ideal for:

  • Digital product stores (eBooks, music, PDFs)
  • Membership sites, LMS platforms, and subscriptions
  • Stores looking to automate WooCommerce order workflows
  • High-volume WooCommerce businesses

Free Features

Automation & Rules
– Automatically complete orders after successful payment
– Rules based on payment method and customer role
– Global enable/disable option

Product Type Compatibility
– Simple products
– Variable products
– Virtual and downloadable products

Order Status & Display
– Display payment method on order page
– Custom thank-you message on checkout success page

Performance & Compatibility
– Optimized for large WooCommerce stores
– Compatible with all major payment gateways
– Safe to use on live production websites

Premium Features

Unlock PRO for advanced WooCommerce automation:

  • Product-specific auto complete rules
  • Variable-product-only targeting
  • Product picker for selective automation
  • Category-based completion rules
  • Region-based payment gateway control
  • Admin and customer email notifications
  • Import and export settings
  • Advanced automation logic

Upgrade to PRO – Coming soon

Notes

Supported payment gateways include PayPal, Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Square, Amazon Pay, Klarna, Afterpay, and Venmo.

Cash on Delivery, Bank Transfer, and Check payments are not supported by default and require manual order review.

Summary

WooCommerce Auto Complete Orders is a simple and powerful solution to automate WooCommerce order completion.

Save time, reduce manual work, and streamline your store’s order workflow — even for high-volume shops processing 20,000+ orders.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/autocomplete-for-woo-orders/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Smart Autocomplete
  4. Enable your automation rules
  5. Orders will now complete automatically after payment
sections.faq:
Does this plugin automatically complete WooCommerce orders?

Yes. Orders are automatically marked as Completed after successful payment, based on your configured rules.

Which product types are supported?

Simple, Variable, Virtual, Downloadable, and Virtual + Downloadable products are supported.

Does it work with physical products?

Yes. Physical products can be auto-completed if payment is successful, depending on your store workflow.

Does it work with Cash on Delivery or Bank Transfer?

No. Cash on Delivery, Bank Transfer, and Check payments are excluded by default for safety reasons.

Which payment gateways are supported?

All gateways that mark orders as paid, including PayPal, Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Amazon Pay, Klarna, Afterpay, Venmo, and more.

Will WooCommerce emails still be sent?

Yes. All default WooCommerce emails continue to work normally.
